deployments_detail.use: Uses machine learning on serialised/digitised equipment movements (BRIX platform, digital CHEP pallets) to reduce idle time across 348 million assets globally

Generative AI used to optimize the movement and efficiency of Brambles' global fleet of pallets, crates and containers across 60 countries, reducing idle time and circulation needs (asset productivity) [not disclosed]
deployments_detail.value: Salvaged 25 million additional pallets in FY25 vs FY21; fleet of 348 million assets

deployments_detail.use: Brambles Intelligence Exchange (BRIX): AI-driven cloud platform (built by BXB Digital) that uses data from IoT-enabled assets to anticipate and address supply-chain challenges and provide end-to-end visibility [BXB Digital (Brambles proprietary)]

Smart assets: pallets fitted with autonomous cellular IoT tracking devices (BXB Digital 'Ultra' device) feeding ML analytics for real-time location, demand prediction and fleet optimization [BXB Digital]
deployments_detail.value: ~450,000 autonomous tracking devices deployed (FY23); 250,000+ reported in 2022

deployments_detail.use: Serialisation+ program in Chile: all CHEP pallets tagged with low-cost QR codes, read by computer-vision cameras at trucks/warehouses to automate inventory management and audits [not disclosed]
deployments_detail.value: 2.6 million pallets tagged in Chile; US expansion targeted within 12 months (fleet ~100M)

deployments_detail.use: Production ML algorithm running alongside a rule-based system to decide when and how to contact customer locations to ensure successful collection/recovery of CHEP assets (loss reduction) [in-house (Brambles ML team, MLOps)]
Machine learning and digital optical (computer vision) capabilities in service centers to instrument plant/pallet repair and fault detection as part of supply-chain digitization [not disclosed]
deployments_detail.value: 20% reduction in tag costs; ~$73M supply-chain productivity savings; 0.8pt margin improvement in period

deployments_detail.use: AI used in recruiting/talent-acquisition to automate and enhance the candidate application experience, with human reviewers retaining decision authority [not disclosed]
Microsoft Copilot / generative AI platform adopted internally (dedicated 'Platform Manager - Copilot' role to manage the Copilot generative AI capability) [Microsoft (Copilot)]
